text:
Nothing ever started, nothing ever ended. Things have been, things shall be. There’s a little sunshine today. Few clouds cleared and I could feel the sun. Then there were clouds again: the sun’s playing hide and seek with me. I have questions: big ones. I feel comfortable living with them. There’s no intention to find answers to those questions, but just let them tag along.

Ideal weather Sunrises at around 8.00 and brightens up by 9.00. It stays the way till evening 6.00. There’s cool breeze blowing by. The sun shines nonetheless. The clouds come and go. But don’t stay the way they should. It’s sunny and cool.

I wish I were an introvert who loved solitude. Seems that I crave for human company often. Be it through sexual gratification, romantic affairs, friendship, relationships and so on.

The perceived emptiness of space and time mesmerises me. After a filling lunch of rice, sambar and uppit, I sit in front of my twenty-four inch display to write a journal entry. Listening to the ambient sounds of vehicles passing by, neighbours talking and hawkers with their loudspeakers trying to sell a thing or two; I sit and type. The VPN connection is taking forever to connect to its servers.

Another day of watching B.R Chopra’s Mahabharat. Is laziness a virtue? I try to be lazy all the time. Even with reading scriptures. I’d prefer to watch a TV series of the same instead. Why has reading books become a boring activity? Because there are no pictures in it? Or there is no movement of characters? My erstwhile habits are withering away. I spend more time wondering about things and stay there. Skills of programming, engineering etc. are fading away. I just eat, sleep and defecate. Well, I do a few home chores too, but they don’t match my skill investment. I’m slowly forgetting what I was supposed to hone. I call up Praveen, a college friend of mine for a casual chat. Career, marriage and money were the topic of discussion. I’m not interested in any of those. My emptiness is pervasive, it won’t go away. No matter how many things, people or events try to fill it. I need to make peace with my loneliness.

When I look at a thing, I keep staring at it for long. I look at the backlight of the keyboard and keep observing it for long. I look at the window and just witness it. I look at the sky and see the clouds passing by. I witness existence and remain peaceful. There’s beauty. There’s enough beauty around for a lifetime. All there is to see and listen and taste and smell and be. No matter what happens I continue to live my experience. What is pain? Physical, emotional, mental or some other? I feel and endure it. What is pleasure? An outburst of orgasm, a dopamine hit or a neurological activity for simulating neurons responsible for pleasure? My thoughts seem to disappear even before they arrive. They fade away.
Should I travel to Mysore to stay with relatives just for the sake of experiencing a better weather?

I’m amidst relatives. Feeling delirious and drowsy at the same time. Sometimes these changes are just changes that I see. I try to see through. There’s no desire to be good and better, also no desire to be bad and poor. Just want to be. Exist. Thrive. Live.

Staying at a guest house away from home with relatives. Visited Kukke Subrahmanya Temple with them for performing rites and rituals. Feeling drowsy after the evening snack and have to wake up very early tomorrow to finish the left over ceremonies as part of the ritual.

A lecture from U, S, and others yesterday made me overwhelmed with external energy. I would rather go nowhere and just sit where I am. Or maybe go to a well known place. I’ve been bombarded with opinions. I don’t feel like pandering to their expectations. Want to stay back. Sit back and be. It’s cloudy today with no sun. I am tempted to take actions, make changes, move to places, try new things and so on. However, I feel threatened by the change itself. I have been called ’dead’ by U.

I decide to go home. I await for tomorrow morning. Will I really be back at home? Not sure. As I wait…
An emotionally charged day so far.
